item: NBA Terms §6 restricts links to internal pages
detail: This site cites nba.com game, schedule and statistics pages directly as row sources. NBA Terms §6 permits word links from non-commercial sites only to NBA home pages or team home pages, and states that links to internal pages are not permitted. Written permission has not been obtained. Source links are retained because they are the audit trail the project requires; the conflict is disclosed, not resolved.

item: Korean statute effective date differs between views
detail: The whole-law page shows [시행 2026. 9. 3.] for Act No. 21742; the Article 26 view of the same Act shows [시행 2026. 6. 2.]. The article text itself was read and quoted. Which date governs is not resolved here.

item: NBA Terms §9 bars gambling-connected use of NBA Statistics
detail: The project's purpose is originating betting lines. Terms §9 says NBA Statistics may not be used in connection with any gambling activity, including legal gambling activity. No authorisation exists. All model outputs are labelled research, no picks or wagers are published, and no NBA statistics bulk feed is used. Legal review required.

The 15 game lines and 7 prop lines come from DraftKings quotes relayed by ESPN's public odds API. No official sportsbook page or licensed odds archive was read; capture times are not recorded, so CLV cannot be computed. Every such row carries an UNVERIFIED badge.

item: Press-reported prop and parlay restrictions are unconfirmed
detail: Four press reports describe NBA restrictions on certain prop bets and parlays. The official NBA release of 26 Oct 2026 refers to restrictions without listing them, so the specific claims stay blank and unverified.

item: Most historical rows were not re-read in this session
detail: The 15 Nov 2 final scores were verified row by row. Of the 92 earlier rows, 13 were re-read by an earlier session; the rest carry a prior-session badge. Aggregate cross-check: recomputed W-L from all 107 rows equals the official 30-team standings.

item: One player-pair correlation uses ESPN game logs
detail: The Mitchell-Allen teammate correlation (r = -0.4222, n = 6) is computed from ESPN player game logs, not from an NBA official source, and n is far too small to use. It is not used to price any combination.
